description: Four-channel mixer, 10HP, summing to one mono output

params.text: That channel's level in the mix, linear in decibels unless LINEAR is enabled
The level of the whole mix, linear in decibels unless LINEAR is enabled
Linear in amplitude, which suits mixing CV; otherwise linear in decibels

inputs.text: One of the four signals summed into the mix
A 0-10V CV over that channel's level, attenuated by the channel's own knob
A 0-10V CV over the level of the mix, attenuated by the MIX knob

outputs.text: The sum of the four channels, hard clipped at 12V unless that is turned off on the menu

notes: the polyphony of the whole module comes from the channels of the cable at the first IN
menu: Disable output limit — lets the output go past the usual 12V cap
